phase2.a5.homework.title: Homework and method review
phase2.a5.homework.brief: Read the five groups, decide an order and use your eighteen units where they will help most. You can practise at the desk before beginning the paper.
phase2.a5.homework.criteria: Each group carries twenty academic marks. Use a sound method, support the conclusion and explain its limits. These marks are separate from tower rank.
phase2.a5.homework.recovery: Missing the deadline does not close this work. Complete it when you can, or practise the method first. A late submission is recorded separately from diagnostic marks.
phase2.a5.assessment.title: Class XI academic assessment
phase2.a5.assessment.brief: A ninety-minute paper has eighteen five-minute units. Survey the groups, allocate time, and choose whether to work through, verify or bound each answer.
phase2.a5.assessment.criteria: Five groups are worth twenty marks each. Feedback distinguishes an unsound method, unsupported conclusion, wasted time, unclear explanation and unfinished work.
phase2.a5.assessment.recovery: If you could not finish, your record keeps the work you submitted. Use its feedback to choose related method practice. Work submitted after the deadline is labelled late without changing diagnostic marks.
phase2.a5.desk.title: Study desk
phase2.a5.desk.empty: No work has been issued. You can still practise.
phase2.a5.paper.time: Reading and planning cost no time. Beginning reserves a ninety-minute block. Submit charges that block once; discarding a draft charges only the five-minute units already spent.
phase2.a5.paper.back: Back keeps the paper open. Submit or discard the draft before beginning another activity.
phase2.a5.record.distinction: Academic marks are separate from tower rank.
